Name: Main Manu Volume Slider
Author: witchtopia
Description:
[center][left][b]Main Menu Volume Slider[/b] adds a simple, vanilla-style music volume slider beside the mute button on Stardew Valley’s title menus.[/left]
[/center]

My friends and I were tired of opening Stardew and immediately getting blasted by the main menu music, only to discover our choices were apparently [i]listen to it at its current volume[/i] or [i]banish it from existence entirely.[/i]

So... now there’s a slider. 🎚️

[center]🎵━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎵[/center]

[size=4][b]🎶 MOD FEATURES[/b][/size]

🎚️ [b]Title Screen Volume Control[/b]
Adjust Stardew Valley’s music volume without loading a save first.

🔊 [b]Right Beside the Mute Button[/b]
The slider appears alongside the existing music mute button, where you’d probably expect a volume control to be in the first place.

🏠 [b]Available Across the Title Menus[/b]
The slider stays available anywhere Stardew keeps the mute button visible, including:

• Main Menu
• New Game / Character Creation
• Load
• Co-op

🎨 [b]Vanilla-Style UI[/b]
Uses Stardew Valley’s own options slider design, so it blends naturally into the existing menu instead of looking stapled on. Because of this, if a recolor/interface mod changes the vanilla UI assets that Stardew’s normal option sliders use, the main-menu slider should inherit those changes automatically.

💾 [b]Your Volume Setting Is Saved[/b]
Adjusting the slider changes the same music volume setting used by Stardew’s normal Options menu.

[center]🎵━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎵[/center]

[size=4][b]📦 REQUIREMENTS[/b][/size]

• [url=https://smapi.io/][b]SMAPI[/b][/url] 4.0.0 or later
• Stardew Valley 1.6

No Content Patcher required.

[center]🎵━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎵[/center]

[size=4][b]🛠️ INSTALLATION[/b][/size]

1. Install SMAPI if you haven’t already.
2. Download [b]Main Menu Volume Slider[/b].
3. Extract the mod into your [b]Stardew Valley/Mods[/b] folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI.
5. Enjoy being able to turn the title music down instead of declaring total silence. 🎶

[center]🎵━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎵[/center]

[size=4][b]💚 COMPATIBILITY[/b][/size]

[b]Interface/recolor mods should generally be compatible.[/b] Main Menu Volume Slider uses Stardew Valley’s existing OptionsSlider UI and vanilla interface textures rather than custom assets, so recolors that modify those assets should also affect the added slider. Mods that substantially replace or restructure the title menu may require compatibility patches.

[center]🎵━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎵[/center]

[size=4][b]🐛 BUGS & FEEDBACK[/b][/size]

If the slider disappears somewhere the title-screen mute button is still visible, appears in a strange position, or decides to otherwise develop opinions of its own, please leave a bug report with your SMAPI log.

And if you find another title-menu mod that needs a compatibility patch, feel free to ask!

[center]🎵━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━🎵[/center]

[size=4][b]✨ CREDITS[/b][/size]
